biggest_catch: Shopkick shut down entirely on March 27, 2026 with no notice — walk-in kicks are gone, unredeemed kicks were wiped out, and the app no longer works.
catches: Wikipedia lists Shopkick as 'Defunct March 27, 2026'; the app was removed from iOS and Android.
couponsinthenews.com (2026-03-30) reports the shutdown took users' earnings with it — unredeemed kicks became worthless with no recourse.
Shopkick deleted its social media and website immediately, posting no farewell or closure notice.
Do not download any lookalike 'Shopkick' apps; the program is gone.

c1.evidence: Shopkick is defunct as of March 27, 2026 (Wikipedia infobox); the app was removed from app stores; the website and socials were deleted.

c2.evidence: No official terms remain — shopkick.com was deleted at shutdown.

c3.evidence: No fee involved; moot — the program is dead.

c4.evidence: No payout is possible; nothing to quote.

notes: Death evidence: Wikipedia 'Shopkick' infobox: 'Defunct March 27, 2026' — 'The app is not currently available for iOS and Android devices'; couponsinthenews.com 2026-03-30: 'Shopkick Suddenly Shuts Down, Taking Users' Earnings With It' — unredeemed kicks became worth nothing, with no recourse per the app's own terms ('Shopkick could cease the Shopkick App entirely'). Applies equally to R0525 (Scan) — same app, same shutdown. The catalog hypothesis that Shopkick was active was outdated.
